limitations: A failing or incomplete attempt does not qualify a target; failures and missing reports remain explicit.
All absolute and growth caps retain their preexisting values; the added64MiB late-median and5s observation-gap budgets were declared before measurement.
The separate53-case functional suite is not run by this selected performance-only configuration.
Even a passing15minute disposable Linux run does not satisfy the required eight-hour installed working-day soak, full ten-target native matrix, vendor traffic or any whole readiness gate.
BSD public-source mapping was approved and the corrected four-target core fixture qualified separately; installed desktop acceptance remains distinct.
Mac launch diagnostics, private-output architecture selection and signing identity/service details remain separate holds.

The candidate reserves root scrollbar space and bounds the body minimum to available width; all production shadows remain. Original case36 adds background geometry assertions. No rendering or scrollbar performance cause was proven by the preceding shadow experiment.
Whole-job CPU and callback clocks do not establish per-function CPU or actual paint timestamps; one cohort does not establish repeat reliability.
